description: This panel aims to compare the measurements for which there are exterior and interior data, so trends and other patterns could be visualized in parallel .

panels.description: Dashboard to compare Temperature (Indoor vs Outdoor). Filtering by pilot, scenario and sub_scenario is possible.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "AIR_QUALITY")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "CONTINUOUS_MONITORING_")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "temperature")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id_pilot =~ /^${pilot:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sub_scenario =~ /^${sub_scenario:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.area =~ /^${area:regex}$/)

from(bucket: "AIR_QUALITY")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "CONTINUOUS_MONITORING_")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "out_temperature")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id_pilot =~ /^${pilot:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sub_scenario =~ /^${sub_scenario:regex}$/)

panels.title: Temperature (In vs Out)

panels.description: Dashboard to compare PMs (Indoor vs Outdoor). Filtering by pilot, scenario and sub_scenario is possible. Only PM2.5 and PM10 are compared here.

targets.query:
from(bucket: "AIR_QUALITY")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "CONTINUOUS_MONITORING_")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._field == "pm10" or r._field == "pm25" or r._field == "out_pm10" or r._field == "out_pm25")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id_pilot =~ /^${pilot:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.sub_scenario =~ /^${sub_scenario:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.area =~ /^${area:regex}$/)

panels.title: Particles Matter (PM2.5, PM10) (In vs Out)

list.description: Allows filtering air quality data by type of scenario locations.
list.label: Scenario
list.name: scenario
list.query: Canteens (CAN) : CAN, Lecture Halls (LEC) : LEC, Residence Homes (RES) : RES, Retirement Homes (RET) : RET, Schools (SCH) : SCH, Homes (HOM) : HOM, Hospitals (HOS) : HOS, Markets (MKT) : MKT, Metro Stations (MET) : MET

list.definition:
from(bucket: "AIR_QUALITY")
  |> range(start: v.timeRangeStart, stop:v.timeRangeStop)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r._measurement == "CONTINUOUS_MONITORING_")
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.id_pilot =~ /^${pilot:regex}$/)
  |> filter(fn: (r) => r.scenario =~ /^${scenario:regex}$/)
  |> group(columns: ["sub_scenario"])
  |> distinct(column: "sub_scenario")
  |> keep(columns: ["_value"])
